arguments.where: id IN (SELECT id FROM failed_jobs WHERE jsonb_path_exists(data, '$.malformed') LIMIT 47)

arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the system for further issues. If the connection pool exhaustion persists, consider optimizing the database connections or increasing the pool size.
